choice.combine: Body keeping its own daily rhythm

expectation: The light-cycle signals should help bring the body's rhythm into step with the day.

reaction: The connection to adjusting after changing time zones was a useful surprise.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the body's rhythm with the light-cycle signals was most worthwhile: it connected the two projects and explained why adjusting to a new time zone takes time.

leastWorthwhile.text: The retina and day-night pairing was straightforward, but its result showed a pathway without explaining much about how the signal adjusts the rhythm.

surprise.text: Sleepiness still rose and fell in unchanging dim light; sunrise is not needed to create the daily rhythm.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: each pairing followed a stated goal, though how the brain adjusts the rhythm remained unexplained.

continue.text: I would continue to see another everyday body process explained; the time-zone connection made this short chapter interesting.
